responsibility: This source file is GCC’s language-independent implementation of attribute registration, lookup, validation, merging, and application on trees. It owns the global and scoped attribute tables used by front ends, checks attribute table consistency, drives decl/type attribute processing through attribute_spec callbacks, handles common diagnostics and ignored-attribute policy, supports namespace-qualified and standard/C++11-style attributes, and implements utilities for comparing, copying, removing, and pretty-printing attributes, including internal handling of access and fn/arg-spec metadata that later middle-end analyses consume.
same_name_distinction: Implements the attribute subsystem’s executable behavior—registration, lookup, validation, merging, application, and plugin-facing registration—whereas gcc/attribs.h only declares the shared interfaces, helpers, and inline lookup/canonicalization utilities for that subsystem.
